title: Nightly Review CRDs
description: Dedicated CRD chart for nightly-review (ReviewRun + Proposal). Golden rule: CRDs in a separate chart with a separate lifecycle. No tunable values. REQUIRED BY core-provider, which reads values.schema.json to derive the Composition CRD and fails observe without it — a chart that renders and publishes cleanly still wedges Synced=False on install.
